home.title: Welcome to my portfolio
home.description: I am a passionate developer focused on creating modern web experiences. With solid experience in React, TypeScript, and backend technologies like NestJS and MySQL, I strive to build intuitive, performant, and maintainable interfaces. My goal is to design solutions that combine performance, aesthetics, and accessibility to deliver the best possible user experience.
